title: Ercel Orser Demonstrating His Potato Sprayer, 1940s
description: Ercel Orser, a Hartland blacksmith on the right, was demonstrating his new potato sprayer in the 1940s, which allowed the farmer to spray for potato beetle effectively and efficiently. Driver is unidentified.
